cells.tense: You are reading the pattern in front of you before it has any words yet.
cells.act: state the order of things once, without argument
cells.ask: Pick one read of the situation you are in and say it out loud once, to someone who has not heard it. Make no case for it and offer no defense. Then hold off talking and leave it standing there.
cells.core:
This is going well, and what it looks like is simple: you see how a thing works, stripped of who is involved and what it is about. It arrives clean. You reach the bottom of something before the others do, and they can feel you are right before they can say why.

There is a second half you tend to skip. Seeing the shape is only part of it. The other part is saying it plainly, as yours, before anybody asks. The pattern can stay in your head for a long time and still be true. It becomes useful the moment you put it where people can hear it. Once is enough. Then wait and see what they do with it.
cells.sheetLine: The pattern is right. Say it or it stays yours alone.
cells.verb: Holding several true readings of what is before you at once, without forcing them into one
cells.place: Where things move as shapes you can see through

cells.tense: You are bracing for a conversation that has not happened, one you are already rehearsing in fragments.
cells.act: turn toward the one direction and stop surveying
cells.ask: Take the thing you keep circling and hold it to one heading for three days. Not the cleverest read, the one you want. When you catch yourself surveying the rest, come back to that heading and keep going.
cells.core:
You have more readings of this than you can hold, and every one of them is accurate, and the accuracy is the problem. Nobody has asked you which one is true yet, and you are already running all of them. Holding this much has stopped being a gift. There is a room you pace in, and the pacing is what it costs.

Seeing less will not help. Orienting will. Pick the one direction. Not the cleverest read. The heading you want, the one your gut would take if the small voice would quit auditing everything. Once you choose, you are not surveying anymore. The other readings do not vanish. They stop being live options, and you are moving.
cells.sheetLine: You know the whole sky. Pick the one you steer by.

cells.tense: The pattern was plain once, and you are standing in a place where it is not.
cells.act: choose one connection and flow with it
cells.ask: Choose one person you are already in it with, and once this week work the next hour alongside them on the same thing, side by side, no division of labor. Let the pattern come together while the two of you are in it.
cells.core:
You could see how something worked, and now it will not arrive the way it used to. The pieces are there but the shape they make is not, and the shape used to come easy. What you are reading is not wrong. It just is not reaching you.

That is no failure of sight. It is a crossing not yet made. The shape that used to come whole now needs someone else in it before it settles, someone building alongside you, not agreeing with you. Say one piece of it out loud to that person. You do not lose it that way. It comes back where it can move again, and the two of you go on with it.
cells.sheetLine: The read is not wrong. It needs another person to land.

cells.tense: You are acting on a clear read of a situation and not calling it yours.
cells.act: let the inner compass decide the small case
cells.ask: On the next small call where no one is watching and no rule covers it, wait a beat and take the read your own sense gives you over the one you could argue for. Then move. Nothing to say about it after.
cells.core:
There is a read of how this actually works, where the fairness sits, and you are already acting on it. The page is written. What is missing is your name at the bottom. If someone asked, you would tell them the situation is simply clear, or the other person is being reasonable, or anyone would do the same.

Seeing it was not the problem. The problem is that it runs unmarked. You make the small fair call and do not clock it as yours. Naming it to yourself before you move does not change what you do. It changes whether you were the one doing it. That is the whole difference: not more fairness, more of you standing behind the fairness already there.
cells.sheetLine: The read is clear. The hand is yours. Say so.
